note: HAND-AUTHORED source for the `patterns` section of component-registry.json. Patterns are the layout/composition layer: Figma component sets that govern how a container is laid out, each bound to one `size / semantics` token family. They deliberately do NOT map to a code component — there is no `PatternCard` export — which is why they cannot come from MDX figmaMeta like components do. Edit here, then run `npm run generate:component-registry`.
